# Phase Logic Narrative: R-501 Monomer Feed

**Phase name:** MONO_FEED
**Unit:** R-501, 10 m³ jacketed semi-batch polymerization reactor
**Status:** DRAFT for review by process, controls, and the hazard review team

> **Note on values.** Values marked **[TBD]** or **[proposed]** are placeholders for discussion and are not design values. Accumulation limits, deviation bands, and timers must come from the reaction calorimetry data and the hazard review.

---

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This phase feeds monomer into R-501 at the recipe rate until the recipe total is delivered. It continuously checks that the monomer is being consumed by the reaction. The phase stops feeding automatically whenever reaction, mixing, or cooling conditions indicate monomer may be accumulating.

**In scope:** FIC-510 feed control, totalization, accumulation monitoring, and feed permissives and interlocks.

**Out of scope:**
- Reactor temperature control (TIC-505, TIC-506, TV-506A/B). This is assumed to be owned by a separate Reactor Temperature Control phase running in parallel, which holds 80 °C. The Monomer Feed phase reads these signals but does not own them. See §9, item 1.
- The SIS at 95 °C. It is independent of this phase. This phase does not depend on the SIS, and the SIS does not depend on this phase.

---

## 2. Equipment and Signals

| Tag | Description | Use in phase |
|---|---|---|
| FIC-510 | Monomer feed flow controller | Owned. Setpoint, PV, output, totalizer |
| XV-510 **[TBD tag]** | Monomer feed tight shut-off valve, fail-closed | Owned. A control valve alone is not credited as positive isolation |
| TIC-505 | Reactor temperature (master) | Monitored |
| TIC-506 | Jacket temperature (slave) | Monitored: PV, SP, output |
| TV-506A | Cooling water valve (split range) | Monitored: position/demand |
| TV-506B | Steam valve (split range) | Monitored: position/demand |
| A-501 / SI-501 | Agitator run status and speed | Monitored |
| CW flow, CW in/out temp **[TBD tags]** | Jacket heat removal measurement | Monitored (needed for heat-balance accumulation method, §6.3) |
| SIS trip status **[TBD tag]** | 95 °C SIS trip feedback | Monitored |

---

## 3. Parameters

### 3.1 Recipe (formula) parameters

| Parameter | Typical | Units | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| FEED_TOTAL_SP | recipe | m³ (or kg) | Total monomer to charge |
| FEED_RATE_SP | 1.2 | m³/h | Normal feed rate |
| FEED_RATE_HI_LIM | [TBD] | m³/h | Max allowed rate. Recipe entry clamped to this |
| INIT_CHARGE | [TBD] | m³ | Initial limited quantity fed to confirm initiation (§5, Step 3) |
| RXN_TEMP_SP | 80 | °C | Confirms Temp Control phase is at correct SP |

### 3.2 Engineering (non-recipe, access-controlled) parameters

| Parameter | Proposed | Units | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| T_START_BAND | ±2 [proposed] | °C | TIC-505 must be within band of SP to start/restart |
| T_LOW_HOLD | 76 [proposed] | °C | Low reaction temp → hold feed (reaction slowing, accumulation risk) |
| T_HIGH_HOLD | 85 [proposed] | °C | High reaction temp → hold feed, before 88 °C alarm |
| T_HIGH_ALM | 88 | °C | Reaction high temperature alarm (given). Feed hold also forced |
| AGIT_MIN_SPEED | [TBD] | rpm | Minimum SI-501 speed for feed |
| AGIT_LOSS_DELAY | 2–5 [proposed] | s | Debounce on agitator loss |
| COOL_MARGIN_HI | 90 [proposed] | % | TV-506A demand above this = cooling margin exhausted |
| COOL_MARGIN_T | [TBD] | min | Sustained time at COOL_MARGIN_HI before hold |
| INIT_TIMEOUT | [TBD] | min | Max time to see exotherm after INIT_CHARGE |
| ACCUM_HOLD_LIM | [TBD from hazard review] | % of total or kg | Calculated unreacted monomer → hold feed |
| ACCUM_RESTART_LIM | [TBD, < ACCUM_HOLD_LIM] | % or kg | Accumulation must decay below this before restart |
| EXO_MIN_DT | [TBD] | °C | Minimum (Tr − Tj) indicating active reaction |
| FLOW_DEV | ±10 [proposed] | % of SP | FIC-510 deviation alarm band |
| FLOW_DEV_T | [TBD] | s | Deviation persistence before alarm/hold |
| LEAK_FLOW | [TBD] | m³/h | Flow detected when feed commanded closed |
| RESTART_RAMP_T | [TBD] | min | Ramp time from 0 to FEED_RATE_SP on restart |

---

## 4. Start Permissives

The phase cannot start unless **all** of the following are true. Each failed permissive is displayed to the operator by name.

1. The Reactor Temperature Control phase is Running, TIC-505 is in Cascade/Auto, and TIC-506 is in Cascade.
2. TIC-505 SP = RXN_TEMP_SP, and PV is within T_START_BAND.
3. A-501 is running, and SI-501 ≥ AGIT_MIN_SPEED.
4. The SIS is healthy and not tripped. No SIS bypass is active on R-501 temperature trips.
5. TV-506A has available capacity. Cooling demand is below COOL_MARGIN_HI.
6. Prior phases are complete. Initial charge and initiator addition, if applicable, are confirmed by the recipe/unit procedure **[confirm sequence]**.
7. No active R-501 high temperature alarm (88 °C).
8. FIC-510 and XV-510 are healthy (no instrument fault), and XV-510 is confirmed closed.
9. Accumulation calculation is valid (required inputs healthy) and initialized to zero or to the carried-over value. See §6.3.
10. Recipe FEED_RATE_SP ≤ FEED_RATE_HI_LIM, and FEED_TOTAL_SP is within the vessel working volume limit **[TBD]**.

---

## 5. Running Logic (Normal Sequence)

**Step 1: Initialize**
- Acquire ownership of FIC-510 and XV-510.
- Reset the feed totalizer. This applies only on a fresh start, not on restart.
- Initialize the accumulation calculation.
- Record start time and start conditions.

**Step 2: Open feed path**
- Put FIC-510 in Auto with SP = 0.
- Open XV-510 and confirm it open with limit switch feedback within [TBD] s. If not confirmed, go to Hold.

**Step 3: Initiation confirmation charge**
- Ramp FIC-510 SP to FEED_RATE_SP. Feed until the totalizer reaches INIT_CHARGE, then set SP to 0 and close XV-510. Alternatively, continue at a reduced rate **[team to decide]**.
- Wait for evidence of reaction within INIT_TIMEOUT. **All** of the following are required:
  - Tr − Tj ≥ EXO_MIN_DT, or the heat-balance method shows the expected heat release.
  - TIC-506 output has moved toward cooling. TV-506B (steam) is closed.
- If confirmed, go to Step 4.
- If not confirmed within INIT_TIMEOUT, go to Hold with the message "Initiation not confirmed — monomer not reacting." Do not continue the feed automatically.

**Step 4: Main feed**
- Reopen XV-510 if it was closed. Ramp FIC-510 SP to FEED_RATE_SP over RESTART_RAMP_T.
- Hold rate at FEED_RATE_SP. Continuous monitoring (§6) is active for the whole step.
- The operator may *reduce* the rate during the step. Increases above FEED_RATE_SP require recipe change authorization **[confirm policy]**. The rate may never exceed FEED_RATE_HI_LIM.

**Step 5: End of feed**
- When totalizer ≥ (FEED_TOTAL_SP − pre-close allowance [TBD]), ramp SP down and set it to 0.
- Close XV-510 and confirm closed. Put FIC-510 in Manual at 0% output.
- Verify flow < LEAK_FLOW for [TBD] s.

**Step 6: Complete**
- Report the final total, the deviation from the recipe total, the feed duration, and the peak accumulation.
- Release FIC-510 and XV-510, and go to Complete.
- Post-feed digestion and cooldown are handled by subsequent phases. Temperature control continues under its own phase.

---

## 6. Continuous Monitoring During Feed (Steps 3–5)

### 6.1 Automatic Hold conditions (feed stopped, phase goes to Holding)

| # | Condition | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| H1 | SI-501 < AGIT_MIN_SPEED for AGIT_LOSS_DELAY, or A-501 not running | No mixing means no reaction and stratification of monomer |
| H2 | TIC-505 PV < T_LOW_HOLD | Reaction slowing, so monomer is accumulating |
| H3 | TIC-505 PV > T_HIGH_HOLD | Cooling not keeping up with heat release |
| H4 | TIC-505 PV ≥ 88 °C (alarm) | Given alarm point. Feed must already be stopped |
| H5 | TV-506A demand ≥ COOL_MARGIN_HI for COOL_MARGIN_T | No cooling margin left for continued feed |
| H6 | TV-506B (steam) opening during main feed for [TBD] s | Heat needed during an exothermic feed means reaction not consuming monomer |
| H7 | Calculated accumulation ≥ ACCUM_HOLD_LIM | Primary accumulation limit (§6.3) |
| H8 | Tr − Tj < EXO_MIN_DT for [TBD] min during main feed | Loss of exotherm signature |
| H9 | FIC-510 PV outside FLOW_DEV for FLOW_DEV_T | Feed not under control |
| H10 | Totalizer > FEED_TOTAL_SP + overfeed allowance [TBD] | Overcharge |
| H11 | Temp Control phase not Running, or TIC-505/506 taken out of cascade | Loss of temperature control |
| H12 | Bad quality on any signal used in H1–H9 | Cannot confirm safe feed. Fail to safe |
| H13 | SIS trip detected | SIS acts independently. The phase follows to a safe state (Abort is recommended, see §7.4) |

All Hold causes are latched and annunciated with first-out indication.

### 6.2 Alarms only (no automatic action)
- TIC-505 approaching T_HIGH_HOLD or T_LOW_HOLD (pre-alarm bands [TBD]).
- Accumulation ≥ 75% of ACCUM_HOLD_LIM [proposed].
- Feed duration exceeds expected (FEED_TOTAL_SP / FEED_RATE_SP) + [TBD]%.
- Flow detected while the phase is not commanding feed (leak-by). This alarm is active in all phase states, including Idle.

### 6.3 Accumulation monitoring method

The hazard review requirement is met by using **two independent indications**, either of which stops the feed.

**Primary: heat balance (calorimetric).**
- Reaction heat removed: Q_rxn ≈ ṁ_cw · cp · (T_cw,out − T_cw,in), corrected for sensible heat of the feed, accumulation in the vessel mass, and losses **[correlation TBD]**. Alternatively, Q ≈ UA · (Tr − Tj), with the UA basis and fouling allowance to be confirmed.
- Monomer consumption rate: Q_rxn / ΔH_r.
- Accumulated monomer: ∫ (feed rate) dt − ∫ (Q_rxn / ΔH_r) dt.
- ACCUM_HOLD_LIM must be set so that the adiabatic temperature rise of the accumulated monomer (MTSR), starting from the worst credible condition, stays below a limit agreed in the hazard review. The candidate reference points are the 88 °C alarm or a margin below the 95 °C SIS trip.

**Secondary: qualitative signatures.** These are H2, H6, and H8 above. They require no model and protect against heat balance errors.

If the heat balance inputs (CW flow and temperatures) are not instrumented, the primary method is unavailable. The phase would then rely on the secondary signatures, with a conservative feed rate. **This must be accepted explicitly by the hazard review team.**

---

## 7. Exception Handling (ISA-88 States)

### 7.1 Holding / Held

**Holding actions (immediate):**
1. Set FIC-510 SP to 0, then put FIC-510 in Manual at 0% output.
2. Close XV-510 and confirm closed. If not confirmed, raise a priority alarm "Monomer feed isolation failed."
3. Freeze the totalizer. Do not reset it.
4. The accumulation calculation continues to run.
5. Do not change temperature control or agitation. Exception: agitator loss, see the special rule below.

**Held state:**
- Display the hold cause, the current calculated accumulation, and its trend.
- Temperature control continues at 80 °C under the Temp Control phase.

**Special rule: agitator loss with accumulated monomer.**
- The phase must **not** restart A-501 automatically.
- Restarting the agitator on an unmixed charge can cause sudden reaction of accumulated monomer.
- Agitator restart requires an operator decision per a written procedure **[procedure TBD]**, based on the accumulation estimate and time since loss.

### 7.2 Restart

Restart is operator-initiated only. No automatic restart is permitted.

**Restart permissives (all required):**
1. All Hold causes cleared and acknowledged.
2. All start permissives in §4 satisfied.
3. Calculated accumulation < ACCUM_RESTART_LIM. If the heat balance is unavailable, an exotherm signature must be present and Tr must be stable within T_START_BAND for [TBD] min.
4. If the hold cause was H1, H7, or H8: supervisor/engineering authorization is required **[confirm role]**.

**Restart actions:**
1. Open XV-510 and confirm open.
2. Ramp FIC-510 from 0 to FEED_RATE_SP over RESTART_RAMP_T. Do not step to full rate.
3. Resume the totalizer from the frozen value. Return to the step that was active at the time of Hold.
4. If the hold occurred during Step 3, repeat initiation confirmation **[team to decide]**.

### 7.3 Stop

Stop is an orderly early end of the feed. The batch may continue to digestion with less than the full charge.

1. Ramp FIC-510 SP to 0, close XV-510, and confirm closed.
2. Leave temperature control and agitation running.
3. Record the delivered total versus the recipe total, and flag the batch as "Feed incomplete."
4. Go to Stopped.

### 7.4 Abort

Abort is a rapid termination for abnormal conditions. It is triggered by the operator, by a unit-level abort, or by an SIS trip.

1. Close XV-510 immediately (no ramp) and drive FIC-510 to 0% in Manual.
2. Send a request to the Temperature Control phase/unit for maximum cooling: TV-506A full open, TV-506B closed **[confirm with process — appropriate since feed is stopped]**.
3. Keep A-501 running if it is running. Do not start it if it is stopped (see §7.1).
4. Record the abort cause and conditions. Go to Aborted.
5. Clearing the Aborted state does **not** reset the SIS. SIS reset is a separate manual action per site procedure and must never initiate feed.

### 7.5 Failure behavior
- **Controller, I/O, or power failure:** XV-510 and the FIC-510 control valve fail closed.
- **Controller restart:** the phase comes up in Held (or Aborted, per site standard), with feed closed. It never resumes Running automatically.
- **Loss of communications to the HMI:** the phase continues Running only while all monitoring in §6 remains valid. Otherwise it goes to Hold.

---

## 8. Reporting and Data
- Recorded: start/end times, total delivered, rate profile, peak accumulation and when it occurred, min/max TIC-505, max TV-506A demand, and all holds with causes, durations, and restart authorizations.
- Batch flags: Feed incomplete, Initiation retried, and Holds > 0.

---

## 9. Open Items for Review

1. Confirm that temperature control is a separate parallel phase. If MONO_FEED is to own TIC-505/506, §7 must be revised so that Stop and Abort never drop cooling.
2. Confirm that a dedicated tight shut-off valve (XV-510) exists or will be added.
3. Confirm whether CW flow and inlet/outlet temperature instruments exist for the heat-balance accumulation method.
4. Obtain ΔH_r, cp, UA, and adiabatic rise data from reaction calorimetry. Set ACCUM_HOLD_LIM, ACCUM_RESTART_LIM, and EXO_MIN_DT from this data.
5. **Hazard review to decide whether the accumulation feed-stop is credited as an independent protection layer.** If so, it likely cannot reside solely in the BPCS phase logic. It would need SIL assessment and possibly implementation in the SIS (e.g., a feed-valve trip on agitator loss or low reaction temperature).
6. Write a procedure for agitator restart after loss with monomer present.
7. Confirm the sequence and quantity for initiation confirmation (INIT_CHARGE, INIT_TIMEOUT).
8. Confirm the authorization roles for restart after accumulation-related holds.
9. Confirm the Abort cooling action with process engineering.
